DEPTOR, a regulator of mTOR signaling, functions as a metabolic rheostat under nutrient availability and insulin conditions. These components ensure that signaling and nutrient uptake are tightly coupled with membrane trafficking pathways.

Proteins like JAG1 (a Notch ligand) and LRP5 (a Wnt co-receptor involved in metabolic tissue homeostasis) suggest developmental regulation of metabolic tissue architecture and function.
